Name: Framed Recollection
Description: You frame your view with your fingers, causing one Small or smaller object that you can see to be teleported to your hands. You can target objects that have total cover as long as you can still see the object. If the object is being held by another creature that is not incapacitated, that creature can make a Charisma saving throw. The save is made with advantage if the object is a magic item attuned to the creature. On a success, the spell has no effect.
